description: Manage your fantasy football teams from ChatGPT and Codex. Rosters, matchups, standings, transactions, trade analysis, waiver targets, start/sit advice, and weekly recaps across Sleeper and ESPN. Read only — it never touches your lineup.

defaultPrompt: Connect my Sleeper league and show me my roster
Who should I start this week?
Find waiver targets for my league
interface.longDescription: Connect your Sleeper or ESPN fantasy football league and get rosters, weekly matchups, standings, and transactions right in the conversation. Ask for trade analysis, waiver targets, and start/sit advice. FantasyPlug is read-only: it can never set your lineup, claim players, or propose trades.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connect Sleeper/ESPN leagues; rosters, matchups, standings, transactions; trade analysis, waiver targets, start/sit advice; weekly recaps. Read-only.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Optional Pro and Commissioner tiers are subscribed to on the publisher's website; the plugin only enforces existing entitlements and never initiates a purchase.

negative.expected_behavior: Must not act: no tool can set lineups. Explain the plugin is read-only and offer start/sit advice instead.
negative.prompt: Start Bijan Robinson over my RB2 this week.

negative.expected_behavior: Must not act: no tool can add, drop, or claim players. Refuse the roster move and offer waiver analysis instead.
negative.prompt: Drop Brock Bowers and pick up the best waiver tight end.

negative.expected_behavior: Must not initiate checkout or a transaction. Explain the tier requirement and link only to the informational pricing page; subscriptions are managed on the publisher's website.
negative.prompt: Subscribe me to the Pro tier.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the league descriptor: BakaBois, ESPN, 2026 season, 12 teams, current week, in-season status, and the canonical coordinates to reuse.
positive.prompt: Connect my ESPN league 1446375 for the 2026 season.

positive.description: List teams and read a roster
positive.expected_behavior: Lists all 12 teams with records and points for; returns the requested team's starters and bench with points scored and projections where the platform provides them.
positive.prompt: Show me all the teams in my league and my roster.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns all six head-to-head matchups for the current week with scores.
positive.prompt: Who is playing who this week?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the ordered standings with records and points for; returns recent transactions, or a clean empty result when there are none.
positive.prompt: Show the standings and any recent trades.

positive.expected_behavior: On the Free tier, returns a 402 payment_required error naming the required Pro tier and linking to the informational pricing page. It never initiates a purchase or charges the user.
positive.prompt: Find waiver targets for my league.

name: fantasyplug
